blush-paper.$description: Blush Paper — Page canvas, breathing space between pattern sections, card surfaces on quiet pages

ink.$description: Ink — Body text, navigation links, hairline borders, structural grid lines, icon strokes

rose.$description: Rose — Wavy stripe fill in hero/pattern compositions, deeper pink surface variant

haas-grotesk-display-r-web.$description: All UI text: navigation links, body copy, footer, labels. The 14px weight 400 is the default for everything clickable; 20px weight 500 for subheadings and journal titles. This is the working typeface — small, neutral, Swiss-grid functional.

yinka-sans-ultra.$description: Exclusive to the studio wordmark and oversized display moments. The +0.04em tracking at 120px is critical — it gives the dense letterforms air without losing the custom geometric character. Custom face only used at this display scale; never below 80px.
